notes: Streets: E. McMILLAN across the top (north side is Volume 4: 'SEE VOLUME FOUR'), GILBERT AV. along the west (NNE-SSW), CURTIS (printed 40') from Gilbert east to Kemper Lane, ST. JAMES AV. (60') from Curtis south off the bottom edge, KEMPER LANE (60') along the east edge from McMillan south off the bottom edge (east side is Volume 4), ROGERS PL. (50) from Gilbert east to St. James. St. James does not continue north of Curtis (the Orpheum Theatre block is continuous), and Curtis and Rogers do not continue east of Kemper Lane / St. James. Gilbert and Kemper Lane continue north of McMillan. Gilbert: sheet 198 draws only its west line (a plain line, 60' printed between the water pipes) and the east-side lot fronts north of Florence; centreline taken midway (x ~ 1567 - 0.339y north of Curtis; measured midpoints 1131 at Curtis and 758 at Florence). This sheet's Gilbert is narrower than on sheet 197: the east lines agree but sheet 197 puts the west-side lot fronts ~35 ft further west, so the Gilbert centre here sits ~15 ft east of sheet 197's. South of Florence Gilbert widens ('100'' printed at ~(407,3207)); only its east lot line is drawn here, and the Gilbert/Rogers Place centre is placed 50 ft west of that line, near the sheet's west border (it agrees within ~30 px with sheet 197's Gilbert/Rogers point mapped across). The Gilbert/Florence point is in the strip of sheet-197 territory shown faintly on the west margin: only Florence's north line (meeting Gilbert's west line at ~(687,2267)) and its water pipes are drawn; the point uses Florence's centreline from sheet 197 (y = 2921 - 0.763x in this sheet's pixels) and this sheet's Gilbert centreline. Curtis centre ~y 1262-1268 (block lines ~1190 and ~1335). Kemper Lane centre x ~3770 (lot fronts 3666, east line 3874). A gap in the Kemper west line at y 2950-3245 is a paste edge, not a street. No alleys on this sheet.
